key_insight: Class prototypes guide quantum data-embedding optimization using O(B) fidelity evaluations for B samples, replacing O(B²) pairwise evaluations.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces fidelity-evaluation cost during iterative embedding optimization while retaining competitive quantum kernel SVM performance.
method: Use class-prototype separation and sample-to-prototype compactness to derive a measurable lower certificate for class-ensemble distinguishability.
Combine quantum circuit architecture optimization with continuous refinement of embedding parameters.
Derive an RKHS prototype classifier for low-cost model selection and extend to multiple prototypes for multimodal classes.
evidence_signal: Across five benchmark datasets with up to 20 qubits, the method retained competitive kernel SVM performance and showed particularly strong gains over budget-matched pairwise optimization on T-MNIST.
watch_item: Benefits are dataset-dependent, and linear fidelity-evaluation scaling does not establish linear end-to-end runtime.
paper_title: Prototype-Guided Optimization of Quantum Data Embeddings with Linear Cost
